text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — Helios Bank just sent a security questionnaire plus a POC checklist. Main asks: SSO (Okta/SAML), SCIM provisioning for ~50k users (bulk), RBAC group mappings, domain proofing, and pricing for a Dedicated trial. Can @priya_se and @lucas_security triage?
priya_se: On it. Quick clarifying q: domain proofing method? DNS TXT or email validation? Also: do they expect delegated admin provisioning via SCIM?
alex_sales: They said DNS TXT preferred for automation, Okta as IdP, and yes they want delegated admin creation by SCIM for a subset of users (but limited). Also they asked for SAML session >8h for some overnight batch jobs.
julie_solution_eng: We support Okta SCIM (v2) with PATCH and bulk sync. We do not auto-promote users to Admin by default — RBAC is via group-to-role mapping. For SAML we support ACS URL metadata and encrypted assertions. Sample metadata snippet to give them:```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.com/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
(priya_se: feel free to copy this into the Okta app config).
priya_se: Need to confirm NameID format and attribute map they plan to send. Typical mapping: `email` -> NameID, `givenName`, `familyName`, `groups` (for RBAC). Also confirm SCIM attributes they expect for provisioning (e.g., `employeeNumber`, `manager`).
lucas_security: From security side: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and ISO certs, support EU data residency, BYOK via customer KMS, and 1y default audit log retention (extension available). For SCIM: we support PATCH for users and groups and bulk operations; rate limits will apply — recommend they run initial sync as a bulk job with our ingestion API.
alex_sales: Pricing question: Helios wants a 3-month Dedicated trial then a 1yr reserved commit. They asked for an estimate for handling ~4k auth checks/sec steady with burst to 8k. Any rough guidance?
julie_solution_eng: Dedicated pricing is commit-based + optional burst credits. For 4k steady you'd likely be in the 2-GPU-equivalent lane; bursts double that. I'll ping finance for a concrete quote, but estimate ballpark: mid-5-figure/mo region. I'll follow up with exact GPU sizing and expected throughput numbers.
priya_se: A couple of operational caveats: long SAML sessions (8+ hours) are supported via session override per-RP (we can stretch up to 24h), but that increases risk surface — security team will flag it in the questionnaire. Also we need to confirm their session re-auth strategy for SCIM actions.
alex_sales: Legal asked about SCIM deletion semantics — they require soft-delete with a 90-day grace window before hard delete. Can we support that?
lucas_security: Yes — we already support tombstoning users for configurable retention windows and keep audit logs. We'll need a contract addendum to capture retention SLA and deletion requests (eDiscovery). Also confirm SAML signature algorithm (they require RSA-SHA256) and encrypted assertions — both supported.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: New ticket created: `POC-587` (Helios SCIM rate test) assigned to @julie_solution_eng, due in 3 business days.
julie_solution_eng: I'll prepare a short runbook + Okta app template and sample SCIM batch job payloads. Will include a `curl` example for initial sync:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/scim/v2/Bulk -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"Operations": [...]}'
```
alex_sales: :thumbsup: I'll upload Helios's security questionnaire to the ticket and send calendar invite for the POC kickoff. Who can join the call tomorrow 10:00am PT?
priya_se: I can join. Please add me to the invite and drop the Okta metadata they plan to use.
lucas_security: I'll join for security / compliance questions and bring the SOC2/ISO attachments. Also request they send a sample SCIM CSV for size/complexity so we can size the ingestion job.
julie_solution_eng: Confirmed — I'll have the sample config + a quick checklist for DNS TXT proofing and RBAC mapping by EOD tomorrow.
alex_sales: Thanks team. I'll consolidate answers and share with Helios. Next steps: attach security artifacts, send pricing placeholder, run SCIM dry-run once we get sample CSV, and confirm POC kickoff attendees.
